scope: Fix-only successor to accepted 57-ID storage review, plus four named VM/subnet native witnesses; no broad re-review or historical source/CASES edits.

fixes.change: Require both native key1/key2 creation timestamps; empty, missing, malformed, timezone-less and future values remain UNKNOWN. Captured scan time is used whenever context exists; legacy context-free evaluation may use evaluation clock explicitly labeled in evidence. Compare exact total_seconds against integer threshold 7776000, preserving the exact 90-day boundary.
fixes.source_semantics: ARM creation timestamp metadata replaces no secret/key-values read. Pinned source computes epoch/86400, not floored integer days. Empty creation timestamps do not prove no access keys and never justify historical N/A copy.

fixes.change: Require exact selected UUID subscription and full native identities for every account/VM, but demand primaryEndpoints.blob proof only for actual unmanaged VHD backing candidates. Unrelated FileStorage/no-Blob and all-managed native inventories do not require irrelevant endpoint facts. Exact canonical ARM name or reported native endpoint supplies only candidate lookup; actual public-cloud primaryEndpoints.blob binding is mandatory before any VHD key-source result. HTTPS port443/default only; userinfo, foreign hosts/parents, ambiguous origins, unsupported DNS-zone endpoints and malformed/double disk attachment are unresolved. No first-label, substring or name-only join.
limits: AzureDNSZone/sovereign/custom endpoints remain UNKNOWN when relevant backing candidates; unrelated account endpoint capabilities do not block independent VHD proof.
The existing criterion concerns unmanaged OS VHD account key-source configuration; guest encryption, data disks and live key accessibility are separate.

fixes.change: Shared detail owner added storage_account to native full GET kind guard; own storage_config binds blob/file/queue/table singleton identity, exact native resource type and properties object. Case aliases remain valid. Contradictory native kind cannot produce PASS or false N/A.

Existing exact storage child scope authorizer now uses literal Microsoft\.Storage, exact UUID component groups and dot-segment rejection. Native type aliases are still accepted; missing/denied child envelopes remain unresolved and observed full accounts retain configuration-only results under unrelated pagination failure.

Only exact native full GET VNet identities in selected subscription may authorize their actual subnet collection scopes. Declared subnet ID set, unique native full GET child ID/type/API/method/read-only provenance and complete child roster must cohere; incomplete envelopes remain in index as unresolved. No generic descendant-prefix relaxation or customer firewall policy. SW17 association omission now reads full proof from owning NIC/subnet/LB resource, never a nested fabricated properties marker.

Bounded priority-prefix proof reuses existing exact rule-box subtraction. All inbound candidate priorities, types, protocols, native rule IDs and duplicate priorities are checked before ordering. An earlier unresolved selector blocks proof; a known residual public Allow can FAIL before later unknown selectors. PASS requires a complete native literal wildcard Deny covering all sources/destinations/ports/protocols in both families. Merely exhausting samples/known rules is not a PASS.
limits: Native default-only VirtualNetwork/AzureLoadBalancer selectors remain UNKNOWN; no service-tag range expansion or approved policy is fabricated.
This is bounded declared NSG configuration analysis, not internet reachability or traffic-serving proof. Unsupported selectors before a decisive rule remain UNKNOWN.
fixes.native_fixture_correction: The prior good default-only NSG was not proof of PASS. Its native UNKNOWN is preserved in a new test and overlay. The current remote-access deciding fixtures retain actual Azure platform defaults and add native custom wildcard Deny; bad adds an earlier native wildcard Allow. Expected PASS/FAIL statuses were not weakened.

def _storage_account_identity(account, scope):
    """Validate every inventory identity without requiring an unused service."""
    rid = get(account, "id", str)
    pattern = re.escape(scope) + r"/resourceGroups/[^/?#%\\\s]+/providers/Microsoft\.Storage/storageAccounts/([a-z0-9]{3,24})"
    match = re.fullmatch(pattern, rid, re.I)
    if (match is None or any(part in (".", "..") for part in rid.split("/"))
            or get(account, "type", str).casefold() != "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts"
            or get(account, "name", str).casefold() != match.group(1).casefold()):
        raise Unavailable("VHD backing account native identity unresolved")
    proof = get(account, "_provenance", dict)
    if (proof.get("representation") != "full" or proof.get("source_operation") != "get"
            or proof.get("read_only") is not True or proof.get("api_version") != "2023-05-01"):
        raise Unavailable("VHD backing account full GET unavailable")
    get(account, "properties", dict)
    return match.group(1).lower()

def _storage_blob_origin(account, scope):
    """Require a native Blob endpoint only for an actual backing candidate."""
    name = _storage_account_identity(account, scope)
    endpoint = urlparse(get(account, "properties.primaryEndpoints.blob", str))

            or endpoint.username is not None or endpoint.password is not None or endpoint.port not in (None, 443)

            or endpoint.path not in ("", "/") or endpoint.query or endpoint.fragment):
        raise Unavailable("VHD backing account Blob endpoint unsupported or contradictory")

    page fails. This does not attest the unobserved subscription inventory.
    """
    if not isinstance(scope, str) or re.fullmatch(r'/subscriptions/[0-9a-f-]{36}', scope, re.I) is None:
        return set()
    parents = [c for c in snapshot['collections'] if c['type'] == 'storage_account'
               and c['scope'].casefold() == scope.casefold()]
    if len(parents) != 1 or parents[0]['status'] not in ('collected', 'partial'):
        return set()
    accounts, seen = set(), set()
    pattern = re.escape(scope) + r'/resourceGroups/[^/?#%\\\s]+/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/[a-z0-9]{3,24}'
    for row in parents[0]['items']:
        rid = row.get('id')

            return set()

                and proof.get('representation') == 'full' and proof.get('source_operation') == 'get'
                and proof.get('read_only') is True and proof.get('api_version') == '2023-05-01'):
            accounts.add(rid.casefold())
    candidates = [c for c in snapshot['collections'] if c['type'] == 'storage_service']
    counts = {}
    for child in candidates:
        key = child['scope'].casefold()
        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    allowed = set()
    for child in candidates:
        parent, separator, service = child['scope'].rpartition('/')
        service = service.casefold()
        if (not separator or parent.casefold() not in accounts or counts[child['scope'].casefold()] != 1
                or service not in ('blobservices', 'fileservices', 'queueservices', 'tableservices')):
            continue
        expected = child['scope'].casefold() + '/default'
        rows = child['items']
        if len(rows) > 1 or any(not isinstance(row, dict)

                for row in rows):

        # Retain denied/partial envelopes so the consumer cannot infer absence.
        allowed.add(child['scope'])
    return allowed

_storage_blob_origin.source:
def _storage_blob_origin(account, scope):
    """Bind the public-cloud Blob origin to its native full account identity."""
    rid = get(account, "id", str)
    pattern = re.escape(scope) + r"/resourceGroups/[^/?#%\\\s]+/providers/Microsoft\.Storage/storageAccounts/([a-z0-9]{3,24})"
    match = re.fullmatch(pattern, rid, re.I)
    if (match is None or any(part in (".", "..") for part in rid.split("/"))
            or get(account, "type", str).casefold() != "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts"
            or get(account, "name", str).casefold() != match.group(1).casefold()):
        raise Unavailable("VHD backing account native identity unresolved")
    proof = get(account, "_provenance", dict)
    if (proof.get("representation") != "full" or proof.get("source_operation") != "get"
            or proof.get("read_only") is not True or proof.get("api_version") != "2023-05-01"):
        raise Unavailable("VHD backing account full GET unavailable")
    endpoint = urlparse(get(account, "properties.primaryEndpoints.blob", str))
    if (endpoint.scheme != "https" or endpoint.hostname != match.group(1).lower() + ".blob.core.windows.net"
            or endpoint.username is not None or endpoint.password is not None or endpoint.port not in (None, 443)
            or endpoint.netloc.lower() not in (endpoint.hostname, endpoint.hostname + ":443")
            or endpoint.path not in ("", "/") or endpoint.query or endpoint.fragment):
        raise Unavailable("VHD backing account Blob endpoint unsupported or contradictory")
    return endpoint.hostname, endpoint.port or 443
